items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I had Rex Stewart in my band out there.

ctx.x: Just take them and then return them right back.

That (Challenge) - that's it. Boy, that is a record! Lawrence Cookie I mean, music. I love that record... Williams, Rex Stewart, and I don't know who he is. It isn't exciting, it's just beautiful, the arrangement.
You mentioned before that you were working with Jimmy Harrison, the piano player, in Buffalo?
